title: Yep! This is the best beauty box for ME
text: I love it! I signed up around the holidays and I have consistently been satisfied and impressed with the products I receive each month. The box does its job and introduces me to some great new products and brands I wasn't familiar with before. I'm a beauty junkie so that is impressive. And you can check right here on Amazon to see the value of the full-size products, which are usually triple or double the $15. I look forward to seeing what's in the box each coming month and reading the pamphlet with editorial reviews. Also, don't forget to use the discount codes if you want to order additional products from each brand.
label: positive
